en.title: Minimum Speed to Eat All Candies
en.description:
In each unit of time you can eat from only one box/pile, at most d items; eating fewer than d still uses a full unit of time, and leftover capacity cannot carry over to the next box/pile. Find the minimum positive integer speed that finishes everything within the deadline.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for bounds missing from the source and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains n quantities, and the third line contains the deadline h. The original numeric upper bounds are missing; this site adds 1≤n≤200000, quantities in 1..10^9, and h≤10^18. On this site 1≤h; the original does not guarantee feasibility, so this site outputs −1 when it is infeasible.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 6; 4; -1. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Binary search the speed, and check it using the sum of the times ceil(a/d) needed for each pile.
